{"id":1876294937,"question_id":4071,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1767693532,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"18 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1876294937/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Word Squares II","memory":"60 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<vector<string>> wordSquares(vector<string>& s) {\n        int n = s.size();\n        sort(s.begin() , s.end());\n        vector<vector<string>>ans;\n\n        for(int top = 0 ; top < n ; top++)\n        {\n            for(int left = 0 ; left < n ; left++)\n            {\n                if(left != top && s[top][0] == s[left][0])\n                {\n                    for(int right = 0 ; right < n ; right++)\n                    {\n                        if(right != left && right != top && s[top][3] == s[right][0])\n                        for(int bottom = 0 ; bottom < n ; bottom++)\n                        {\n                            if(bottom != right && bottom != left && bottom != top &&\n                            s[bottom][0] == s[left][3] && s[bottom][3] == s[right][3])\n                            {\n                                ans.push_back({s[top] , s[left] , s[right] , s[bottom]});\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"word-squares-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1459}
